$comment: The service-status service behind the status MCP server. Each region has a timeline: successive calls return successive entries (the last one repeats), so a run can observe an incident and then its resolution, and the assembler can supersede the earlier observation. A fault entry makes the call fail that way once.

eu.summary: Elevated API error rates in the EU region; in-app chat delayed. Engineers are rolling back a deployment.
The EU rollback completed; API error rates are back to baseline. A post-incident summary will be published on the status page.
